title: Microservices and serverless hype is cooling
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Fewer stories mention microservices or serverless than at the start of the window.
expect: If true, the share of stories with microservices or serverless should be at most 0.7x as high in the latest 12 months as in all earlier stories since 2006 (pooled) (0.9x counts as weak, 1.1x or higher refutes it).
